item.description: A Rust framework for working with RDF knowledge graphs.

item.title: Dydra
item.description: The first graph database as a service (GDBaaS), a cloud-hosted RDF triple store with a SPARQL query engine.

item.description: RDF.rb 0.3.0 adds transactions, basic graph pattern queries, and fast parsers and serializers for RDFa, Notation3, Turtle, and RDF/XML.

item.title: How RDF Databases Differ from Other NoSQL Solutions

item.description: Introducing the first release of RDF.rb, its design philosophy and object model, with a tutorial on using its core classes.

item.description: How to process RDF data in the line-oriented N-Triples format by pipelining standard Unix tools such as grep, cut, awk, sort, and uniq.
